title: CD with Handwritten Tracklist
coreRelationships: Handwritten text is directly applied onto the reflective surface of a CD.
The CD is enclosed within a transparent, crinkled plastic sleeve, creating reflections and distortions.
The tracklist is organized into two columns, following the curvature of the disc.
The 'Parental Advisory' text is positioned at the bottom left, separate from the main tracklist.
reuseFormula: Generate a photograph of a CD with a reflective, iridescent surface, enclosed in a crinkled clear plastic sleeve. Overlay custom handwritten text for the album title and tracklist, mimicking the informal, marker-like style and placement of the original. Ensure the 'Parental Advisory' text is distinct in its blockier handwritten style and position. The background should be plain white.
